tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Live Jupiter quote for a Solana swap: out amount, min out, route, and a price-impact estimate (hidden for tokens under 24 h old). Returns a plover.markets link where the human reviews and signs in their own wallet. Read-only; never asks for a key.

tools.name: token_facts
tools.description: Facts for a Solana token: market cap, all-time high (from the live DEX pool, not the dead Pump.fun bonding curve), age, Pump.fun graduated yes/no, liquidity, authorities. Facts only, no safety verdict.
